Luminous Tide

Luminous Tide

Hallucinations of Love, by the sea

A beach at sunset that can turn to night. The waves catch the light, the stars come out, butterflies of light spiral up, and three poems drift in slow circles over the sea: Echoes of the Void, Hallucinations of Love, and a new one, Bioluminescence.

This browser can't draw the beach. You can still read all three poems.

Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to look closer. Tap a line in the sky to read it. Tap the water and it lights up. The button at the top turns sunset into night. Nothing plays until you tap Sound; on an iPhone, the silent switch has to be off.

Built with Python: it reads the two original poems from the saved notes, checks every line in the sky against them word for word, and makes the sand, foam and butterfly textures. Your browser then draws it all live with WebGL.
